name: Ensemble Report
summary: Ensemble Report — the estate brain, built from Run the Ensemble. Summarises every specialist's released result (page cache + the Exposure Score / Exposure Routes / SLA Tracker snapshots) into one story: how exposed the estate is and what the risk is made of, where it concentrates (by specialist, on assets, in time), the cross-specialist overlaps no single specialist sees, blind spots, ranked next moves and which specialists the picture was built from. Every number links to the specialist that owns it. Needs a release; reads caches only, never navi.db.
